→ Component keys</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/naming">Naming →</a></li><li><span class="odv-dec-what">Components · How far does the inventory reach? → Only what today's screens use</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/components">Components →</a></li></ul></div></li></ul></li></ul></div></div></section><h3 class="odv-grp">Scopes</h3><section class="odv-qsec" id="typography"><button type="button" class="odv-qsec-h" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="typography-body"><span class="odv-qsec-t">Typography</span><span class="odv-qsec-n">5 answers, 0 decisions, and the values of its tokens</span></button><div class="odv-qsec-b" id="typography-body" hidden><div class="odv-qa" id="typography-roles"><div class="odv-q">Which text roles does it need?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Core: heading, body, label</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Few roles keep pages predictable.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>What must the interface protect? → Low effort to understand</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the typography tokens: <a href="foundations/typography">Typography →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="typography-count"><div class="odv-q">How many steps does the type scale take?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Only the steps the screens need</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Only the sizes the screens need, each clearly different.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>What must the interface protect? → Low effort to understand</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the typography tokens: <a href="foundations/typography">Typography →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="typography-definition"><div class="odv-q">How are sizes and line heights defined?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">A ratio, line heights in proportion</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Line height grows with text size for zoom users.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>What accessibility level do we commit to? → AAA</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the typography tokens: <a href="foundations/typography">Typography →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="typography-values"><div class="odv-q">How large is body text?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Large</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Large text is readable for more people.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>Who uses it most? → Everyone, including people with disabilities</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the typography tokens: <a href="foundations/typography">Typography →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="typography-lands"><div class="odv-q">Where does type do the most work?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Forms and labels</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Type matters most in form labels and hints.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>What is the main content? → Rarely</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the naming tokens: <a href="foundations/naming">Naming →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="naming-count"><div class="odv-q">How many token tiers?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Three</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Primitives, semantics and component keys.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>How fast does it change? → Rarely</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the naming tokens: <a href="foundations/naming">Naming →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="naming-definition"><div class="odv-q">How are decisions named?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">By role</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Role names survive a redesign.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>Who maintains the system? → A platform team</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the naming tokens: <a href="foundations/naming">Naming →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="naming-values"><div class="odv-q">How are names written?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Lowercase words in paths</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Lowercase paths read the same everywhere.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>Who maintains the system? → A platform team</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the naming tokens: <a href="foundations/naming">Naming →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="naming-lands"><div class="odv-q">What do components read?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Component keys</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">A component API keeps changes local.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>How fast does it change? → Rarely</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided (1)</b><div class="odv-dgroup"><div class="odv-dgroup-t"><svg class="odv-kind-icon" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.33" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10.6667 10.6667L12.6667 5.33334L14.6667 10.6667C14.0867 11.1 13.3867 11.3333 12.6667 11.3333C11.9467 11.3333 11.2467 11.1 10.6667 10.6667Z"/><path d="M1.33331 10.6667L3.33331 5.33334L5.33331 10.6667C4.75331 11.1 4.05331 11.3333 3.33331 11.3333C2.61331 11.3333 1.91331 11.1 1.33331 10.6667Z"/><path d="M4.66669 14H11.3334"/><path d="M8 2V14"/><path d="M2 4.66668H3.33333C4.66667 4.66668 6.66667 4.00001 8 3.33334C9.33333 4.00001 11.3333 4.66668 12.6667 4.66668H14"/></svg>Rules it sets (1)</div><ul class="odv-tree"><li><span class="odv-dec-what">For a value with no token, use the closest semantic token, then ask for a new one. Don't use a raw value in the component. A raw value skips the contrast checks every token passed.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/naming">Naming →</a></li></ul></div></li></ul></li></ul></div></div></section><section Common words are understood by the most people.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/voice">Voice →</a></li><li><span class="odv-dec-what">For the words of an error, use say what is wrong, where, and exactly how to fix it. Don't use &quot;Invalid input&quot;. People must be able to fix the error without help.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/voice">Voice →</a></li></ul></div></li></ul></li></ul></div></div></section><section class="odv-qsec" id="components"><button type="button" class="odv-qsec-h" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="components-body"><span class="odv-qsec-t">Components</span><span class="odv-qsec-n">5 answers, 2 decisions, and the values of its tokens</span></button><div class="odv-qsec-b" id="components-body" hidden><div class="odv-qa" id="components-roles"><div class="odv-q">Which component families does it need?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Actions, forms, feedback, overlays, layout and navigation</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Forms, steps and feedback are all a public service needs.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>What is the main content? → Forms and tasks</li><li>Who uses it most? → Everyone, including people with disabilities</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the components tokens: <a href="foundations/components">Components →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="components-count"><div class="odv-q">How far does the inventory reach?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Only what today's screens use</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Only the parts in use, each tested with assistive technology.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>What accessibility level do we commit to? → AAA</li><li>How fast does it change? → Rarely</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the components tokens: <a href="foundations/components">Components →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="components-definition"><div class="odv-q">How does a component earn its place?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">It works for everyone, with any device and assistive technology</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">A component joins only when it works with any device and assistive technology.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>Who uses it most?
